senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (v. גָּרִיס) grist-maker or dealer.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:29">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. R. Jacob <he>ג׳</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1:10">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חווי פירין לג׳</he> showed the produces to a grist-dealer (to value them).—Pl. <he>גָּרוֹסוֹת</he>, <he>גָּרוֹסִים</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 10:4">Men. X, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>רחים של ג׳</he>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite> <cite ref="C01307"><he>גרוסת</he></cite> (corr. acc.) the grist-grinders’ mills; Pesik. Haomer, p. 69ᵃ <he>גריסות</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:1:11">Y. Pes. IV, 30ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:5:3">Y. M. Kat. II, end, 81ᵇ</cite> <he>גָּרוֹסֵי צפורין</he> the grist-makers of Sepphoris.
